test_webhook_payload_deserialize: test WebhookPayload.model_validate to deserialize a webhook JSON payload with comment and event scope fields
test_webhook_payload_without_comment: test WebhookPayload.model_validate to deserialize a webhook payload that has no comment field
test_webhook_payload_with_updated_refs: test WebhookPayload.model_validate to deserialize a webhook payload containing updatedRefs with ref, oldSha, and newSha fields
test_webhooks_server_add_webhook: test WebhooksServer.add_webhook decorator to register webhook handlers with implicit and explicit paths
test_webhooks_server_secret_validation: test WebhooksServer secret validation returns 401 without secret, 403 with wrong secret, and 200 with valid secret
